frequency_question: How often do executive-announced broad trade tariffs actually reach implementation without being permanently withdrawn prior to the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive announcements of broad tariff measures on specific nations or sectors where the executive possesses direct statutory authority; excludes purely rhetorical posturing never formalized into executive action or rules.

cases.name: Section 232 steel and aluminum tariffs (China, EU, Canada, Mexico)
Threatened 5% escalating to 25% tariffs on Mexico over migration
Threatened 10% tariff on Danish goods over Greenland
Resumption of Section 232 tariffs on Canadian aluminum

coverage_note: 5 named major unilateral tariff threats with direct executive directive; 3 implemented, 2 withdrawn following negotiated concessions.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sector-specific anti-dumping duties which follow independent agency tracks.
validity_reason: Tied to the tenure and behavioral patterns of the current executive leadership style.
